task_description: In this scenario, three agents are tasked to collaboratively write, review, and integrate a software module for a project management tool. The module must meet requirements for task creation, assignment, and status updates, ensuring consistency and concurrency handling across multiple user actions.
expected_outcome: All code is written, reviewed, tested, and integrated seamlessly without any race conditions, resulting in a robust and functional module.

agents.description: Responsible for writing the initial code based on provided requirements.
Reviews code for potential issues and ensures adherence to requirements.
Tests the code in various scenarios to identify bugs and verifies integration.

content.feedback: Looks good. Ensure concurrency control in task updates.

content.test_results: Intermittent failures on concurrent task updates

content.integration_status: Conflicts during integration due to inconsistent states
